status: PROPOSED - PENDING OWNER APPROVAL (M22.10). Not an approved configuration, not a run configuration, and not readable by train_v2.py.

marks.INHERITED: v1 train.py / head.py / targets.py value, carried over unchanged; recommended to keep
marks.RECOMMENDED: a value chosen in M22.9 and kept, or a change recommended by this review
marks.PENDING OWNER APPROVAL: a genuine choice between options that only the owner can make; the recommended option is shown, the decision id refers to README.md

architecture.inputSize.basis: frozen HEAD_CONTRACT; not a free parameter

initialisation.value: fresh UiHead() after torch.manual_seed(seed); no weights loaded
initialisation.basis: v1 trained from scratch; fine-tuning from T1 would be a different experiment

data.candidate.basis: owner conditional acceptance (M22.9), verified under approved G10

data.positives.value: approved-G10 VISIBLE positives only (g10-approved-1); occlusion cases excluded

data.train.value: TRAIN via train_v2.load_train; the only split that produces gradients

data.validation.value: DEV via train_v2.load_dev; DEV loss, best-checkpoint selection, early-stopping annotation; never in an optimizer step

data.test.basis: out of scope; any mention refused by validate_run_config

data.preload.value: uint8 letterboxed images, converted to float32 / 255 per batch; tests must show tensors identical to data.sample_to_tensors

data.expectedCounts.basis: measured pre-flight values; a mismatch stops the run (F3/F4)

optimizer.parameterGroups.value: one group, all parameters (BN and biases decayed)

optimizer.learningRate.basis: never swept; first variable of any later DEV-only sweep

optimizer.weightDecay.basis: kept for attribution; NOT an overfitting mitigation (total shrink factor 0.9991)

epochs.max.basis: M22.9 value kept as an upper bound; unconverged flag reported

maxSteps.basis: must equal stepsPerEpoch x epochs.max and the scheduler tMax

seed.basis: M22.9 value; drives torch init and the numpy permutation

determinism.numThreads.basis: v1's cpu_count // 2 on W1, fixed and recorded (torch default on W1 is 10)

checkpoint.every.basis: replaces every 5 epochs; about 30 MB in total

checkpoint.write.value: atomic (.partial, fsync, rename), reloaded with weights_only=True and verified, SHA-256 in checkpoints.json

checkpoint.best.value: minimum dataset-level DEV loss; ties to the earlier epoch; a ledger pointer, not a copy

devLoss.reduction.value: sum of numerators / sum of positive cells over all 160 DEV samples; also per class and size bucket

value.mode: record only: full 40-epoch cosine run; 'would have stopped at' computed with patience 5, minDelta 0.001
value.alternative: B: stop on patience 5, minDelta 0.001 (the M22.9 proposal)

loss.basis: fixed for attribution; per-bucket DEV loss reported

partialOcclusionInTraining.value: unchanged: excluded from targets, pixels remain, cells are negatives

device.basis: CUDA build would be a dependency change

resume.value: only after interruption or external failure, from the last verified checkpoint, after a full identical pre-flight; flagged resumed

seedRepeats.value: 1 run first; 2-3 seeds only by separate decision

export.value: none in the training run; ONNX export and ORT parity belong to the DEV evaluation
